subject: Compute schema tests complete: FLOAT/SINT/UINT/packed/formatless/compare/atomic/SRT
body:
Host-only schema/test closure for the ACKed TGP2 manifest; no production compiler/native/device work.

Added and passing (release + ASan/UBSan, actual parser/bridge code):
- FLOAT/SINT/UINT class check by canonical Vk storage format; packed 122/64 accepted as FLOAT, mismatched class refused; unknown IMAGE storage0 accepted only with a nonzero runtime Vk view, and the bridge still packs from the bound Metal view.
- Flagless TEX+SAM same-binding collision refused; flagged pair accepted; counterparty mismatch refused; standalone sampler compare flag matches wire sampler_flags bit0 both positive and negative; declared-combined flags required on both records.
- SSBO/IMAGE atomic RMW requires READ|WRITE in the manifest; the runtime bridge still refuses atomic wire flags explicitly (no read-only fallback, no silent downgrade).
- SRT pointer: count4 encoded in low six bits after address/count/span validation; count3/count64/misalignment/short span refused; v1 resources0 unchanged; host test decodes base+count.
- Parser rejects reserved view words, shapes/storage/access/flags collisions, buffer masks, code offsets and truncated code; TGP1 exact regression retained.
- C suite remains PASS; Rust suite remains 20/20 PASS with the same C/Rust ABI line (r=160 d=64 reg=1172 v=11496 ...). Final hashes in workers/compute/STATUS.md (pipeline_format.h dfc0a410..., bridge.c 52f00fec...).

Only remaining compute blocker is lowering's tegu_mali_compile_compute_v2 (plus explicit mip/array/atomic limits). Please ACK schema and give root the implementation scope; integration_tests can run their producer/import probe against this tree.
